title: ADD_CHIMNEY payload
description: Add a box chimney as a separate BuildingInstallation body (v0.3 §6 F-37; spec §10.11; GT-17).

center.description: Centre of the base on the roof face.

heightAboveRoofM.description: Top above the lowest (downhill) base corner (D-3D20-1).

$comment: [P] Field names. Box axes = local building axes, widthM along x, depthM along y [A]; heightAboveRoofM at the lowest base corner (D-3D20-1).
